_about: Scene IDs (RSDB/EventSetting rows) the patcher may rewrite for its own scenes, in the order it uses them. The scene table can't grow (adding a row aborts the game at startup), so new scenes reuse rows. These are chest item scenes: each plays only when its vanilla chest is opened, so when a row is reused, that chest keeps its item but plays the normal opening (the patcher removes its scene ID). Rows a plan uses itself are skipped. Late-game and duplicate-purpose rows first; maps and compasses last.
